metadata.description: ALRT-02: Latency Regression alert rule with dynamic thresholds and zone-specific sensitivity. Monitors agent P95 latency and triggers when response times regress beyond learned baselines.
Base name for the alert rule (zone suffix will be appended)
Resource ID of the Application Insights instance to monitor
Resource ID of the Zone 1 (Personal Productivity) Action Group
Resource ID of the Zone 2 (Team Collaboration) Action Group
Resource ID of the Zone 3 (Enterprise Managed) Action Group
Whether the alert rule is enabled
Location for the alert rule resources

properties.description: Alert when agent P95 latency exceeds dynamic baseline. Zone 1 uses Low sensitivity for personal productivity agents with higher tolerance for performance variability.

allOf.query:
// Normalize current workspace-based AppEvents and legacy customEvents into one query shape.
let AgentEvents = materialize(
    union isfuzzy=true
        (AppEvents
        | project timestamp = TimeGenerated,
                  name = tostring(Name),
                  customDimensions = todynamic(Properties),
                  session_Id = tostring(column_ifexists("SessionId", "")),
                  itemId = tostring(column_ifexists("_ItemId", ""))),
        (customEvents
        | project timestamp = todatetime(column_ifexists("timestamp", datetime(null))),
                  name = tostring(column_ifexists("name", "")),
                  customDimensions = todynamic(column_ifexists("customDimensions", dynamic({}))),
                  session_Id = tostring(column_ifexists("session_Id", "")),
                  itemId = tostring(column_ifexists("itemId", "")))
    | extend EventKey = iff(isnotempty(itemId), itemId, strcat(name, "|", session_Id, "|", format_datetime(timestamp, "o"), "|", tostring(customDimensions)))
    | summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by EventKey
    | project timestamp, name, customDimensions, session_Id
);

let ZoneFilter = 'Zone 1 - Personal Productivity';
AgentEvents
| where name == 'BotMessageSend'
| where tostring(customDimensions['Zone']) == ZoneFilter
| extend DurationMs = todouble(customDimensions['duration'])
| where isnotnull(DurationMs)
| summarize P95Latency = percentile(DurationMs, 95)
